prerequisites: Good capacity for comprehensive reading of texts in Spanish and English
Ability to search and identify bibliography
Ability to write reports in Spanish

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the characteristics of projects, their life cycle, and the technical, economic, safety, environmental, legal, social, and ethical conditions to consider in them
Organize and manage projects in multidisciplinary environments
Organize work and manage human resources for projects
Clearly present and adequately justify the solutions adopted in a project, preparing the associated documents that allow its contracting and execution

Define the scope of a project and plan the deadlines and costs of all tasks necessary to carry it out, and monitor the progress and supervision of the work to be performed in a project, keeping the initial planning in mind
Understand the legal and ethical requirements and implications of professional engineering practice, particularly in project development

syllabus_topics: Professional standards and methodologies for project management
Advanced project planning and control techniques
Presentation and defense of group work

assessment_methods.method: Group work, documentation delivery, oral presentation and defense
Final in-person knowledge test (Test and/or short questions, Application case)

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, each of the three parts (group work, individual activities, final test) must be approved with a minimum score of 5 out of 10. The final grade is calculated as 0.5 x Group Work + 0.1 x Individual Work + 0.4 x In-person Test. For the extraordinary call, previously approved group and individual work will be taken into account; otherwise, their score will be 0. A new in-person knowledge test must be passed with at least 5 out of 10. The final grade for the extraordinary call is 0.6 x In-person Test + 0.4 x Work Grade, where Work Grade is 0.2 x Individual Work + 0.8 x Group Work. If no work was approved in the ordinary call, the maximum possible grade in the extraordinary call is 6 points.
bibliography: The project management question and answer book, NEWELL, Michael; GRASHINA, Marina. Amacom, 2003.
Guía de los Fundamentos Para la Dirección de Proyectos (Guía del PMBOK®)–Quinta Edición (SPANISH), Edit PMI, 2014
Project Management: A Systems Approach to Planning, Scheduling, and Controlling H. Kezner, 2013
